searchText: You make it too easy 🙂 I just want full TTD experience this time (without writing tests obviously). https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/27613 Can you also check when TSTORE is enabled? Wdym? you can enable it via the ExtraEIPs, just add 1153 ``` // GetChainConfig takes a fork definition and returns a chain config. // The fork definition can be // - a plain forkname, e.g. `Byzantium`, // - a fork basename, and a list of EIPs to enable; e.g. `Byzantium+1884+1283`. ``` ok, fine Actually, I realized this is not enough because we also need to update bytecodes in tests. Please review: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/795 This PR removes merge transition tests from hive, to make runs faster, and prune code of tests that are no longer necessary. Let me know if there are any objections or this should be delayed 🙂
